verbs.target_semantic: pre-merge probe: the machine-generated list of contested dials; the adjudication note annotates that list instead of re-deriving it (the two true statements about the same fact, written down rather than discarded)
the surface a dispute is worth recording against: enumerate what is currently trusted-but-unaudited at any ref before recording a dispute on it

doubt-grammar discharge record: what stopped being checked, what now covers it, what event reopens it (LEDGER.md fields stopped / covered_by / revisit / status — 'discharge requires a reason' is this repo's thesis in one line)
who held the ref an adjudicated claim came from: names the agent position behind a receipted claim
